articles.headline: Development spending stalls despite surplus
articles.summary: AI summary: Planning ministry data show federal development spending reached only about Rs104bn, or 10.4% of the Rs1 trillion PSDP, in July to October, far below the Rs412bn authorised, even as the budget showed a first-quarter surplus. The NHA used under 6% of its allocation and several ministries spent nothing, suggesting the surplus partly reflects held-back public investment.

articles.headline: 9 pm shop-closing cut daily customer transactions by 42pc: Study
articles.summary: AI summary: A study presented at FPCCI's Lahore office found Pakistan's 9 pm shop-closing rule cut average daily transactions per outlet by 42% and sharply lowered retailers' sales ratings, with women's shopping trips also falling. Public opinion is split, and stakeholders urged consulting traders, allowing later closing times and targeting energy savings through solar and loss reduction instead.
